report: final attempt-009: independent console-proof and recovery review
verdict: CONFIRMED: real M1 (J293/T8103) running the candidate PureDarwin XNU under the pinned m1n1 hypervisor answered a fresh split-nonce command over the guest serial console with adjacent 'Darwin' / 'arm64' / '25.5.0' stdout, without filtering. The controller then reset the target and the returned Linux was verified. This is a serial command line, not a display, desktop or bare-metal claim.

artifact_sha256.note: identical to the attempt-009-partial copies reviewed first

proof_checks.check: challenge bytes equal the controller's expected construction (stdout-only uname group); the 48-hex nonce never appears contiguously in the input

after CR removal the console contains exactly ONE strict match 
DL9_BEGIN_<nonce>
Darwin
arm64
25.5.0
DL9_END_<nonce>
 with adjacent lines; no filtering applied
the full nonce occurs exactly twice in the raw console (BEGIN and END response lines), so no echo contains it
the nonce appears in no other file under runs/ or reports/ (fresh)
the input echo precedes the response; zsh line-editor wrap mangles the echo (expected) but keeps the nonce split. After the response the shell redraws its prompt
console-result.json: command_line_observed true, challenge_sent true, error null, console_sha256 and console_bytes match the raw file

independent rerun of tools/m1_bringup_cycle.console_observation (repo bytes == archived snapshot bb84bae0) on the full guest directory = True; negative control with a wrong candidate kernel hash = False

no 'panic(' in the console; kernel banner 'Darwin Kernel Version 25.5.0: Sun Nov 8 04:26:59 UTC 2026; ...DEBUG_ARM64_T8103' matches the kernel002 build string (UUID 856572B2 established in the attempt-006 review)

6 malloc warnings ('can't mvm_protect(0) region for postlude guard page') come from launchctl and sh startup BEFORE the challenge; none from uname (stderr redirected). This is a real userspace/VM symptom to track; outside the proof
